nav.title: Ikigo Gikorwa na AI
nav.subtitle: Serivisi ikorwa n'ubwite mu ndimi nyinshi hamwe n'ukwakira umuntu wagenwe.

stats.providerQualificationNote: Indimi zizwi neza gusa nizo zijishyirwa mubare

customer.title: Tangira ikiganiro
customer.consentText: Nemeza ko ikiyandikishwe mu bigambo kigashoborwa nibinyamahanga bimwe. Ubwumvikane ubikurikira.
customer.setupHint: Ntibikorwa kugeza umuyobozi afungura urufunguzo rw'ibyangombwa n'injyana yo kwizera.
customer.chatEmpty: Ubutumwa bwawe bwereka ngaho. Ibyigisho bya AI ni inama gusa; nta maniwa, guhindura konti, kugarura cyangwa kohereza bikorwa.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Ijwi ry'urubuga rihererekanywa nk'umugezi rigana ku utanga serivisi wateganyijwe; OpsCore ntivuga ko ibika amajwi atanonosowe.
customer.voiceRequirement: Ijwi ry'urubuga rikenera HTTPS (cyangwa localhost), mikoro, uruhushya, moderi ya Realtime yashyizweho n'urufunguzo rw'utanga serivisi. Ntabwo ari ikiraro cya telefoni cya PSTN/SIP.

queue.title: Urubanza rw'itara
queue.description: Ibiganiro bigezwa ingufu, bidakemurwa cyangwa bisaba umuntu bihura ngano. Ikintu kirabura cyerekana kugenzura, si guhishurwa.
queue.empty: Nta kwakira umuntu kiriho kuri iri shyirahamwe.
queue.replyStorageNote: Ibisubizo by'abantu bishyirwa mu ibanga iyo bibitswe kandi bigaragara mu nyandiko y'ikiganiro.

boundaries.title: Impinduka za serivisi
boundaries.automateBody: Igisubizo cya mbere mu ndimi nyinshi, kumvisha, gutandukanya umubiri n'ingufu, kwibika ikiranga neza, kurema urubyiruko no gutanga umukoresha.
boundaries.humanBody: Kubaza umuntu byerekana, kwizera bike, ingufu kuruhande cyangwa impinduka nyinshi, impaka zidasanzwe, ikibazo kidakemurwa, kujya inyuma ku kizamini cyangwa ibikorwa bitamenyekana.
boundaries.notEnabledBody: Kudindizanya PSTN/SIP/WhatsApp/ibaruwa, irigi rya telefoni rya kubyukira, kwemeza umubiri wa CRM n'ukwizihiriza indimi biba ifumbire y'umutungo, ibyangombwa n'ibizamini by'ukwakira.

messages.qualificationNotice: Nta ndimi ishobora kuba ikoreshwa mu bicuruzwa itangiye ku kizamini cy'umwandiko, ASR, TTS, umugohe no kuzamurwa.
messages.configOk: Iboneza rihari. Kwihangana n'umutungo n'ubwiza bw'indimi biracyasaba ibizamini byo kwakira.
messages.conversationCreated: Ikiganiro ciza kiriwe cyashyizweho. Ubwiza bw'indimi ntibushobora kuba mu bihora.
messages.handoffQueued: Ukwakira umuntu kwinjira mu rubyiruko ({reason}). Iki ni icyifuzo kirabura, si gukoresha ku buryo bwite.
messages.aiResponseFailed: Igisubizo cya AI ntigishobotse. Nta gikorwa cyakorewe. Ushobora kuziza umukozi w'umuntu.
messages.apiUnavailable: API y'Ikigo cy'Itumanaho ntishobora gutangira. Injira muri konsole ya OpsCore, hanyuma wongere utangize iyi paji.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Ihererekanya ku muntu ryashyizwe mu murongo ({reason}). Umurongo ntugaragaza ko umukozi yahujwe.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Ihererekanya ku muntu ryashyizwe mu murongo. Igihe cya AI cy'urubuga kirimo guhagarara; ihererekanya rya telefoni ritaziguye ntiryateguwe.
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Utanga serivisi ya none aha yatangaje ikosa. Hagarika igihe cy'ijwi hanyuma wongere ugerageze nyuma yo gusuzuma imiterere y'utanga serivisi.
messages.voiceActive: Igihe cy'ijwi kirakora. Kanda “Saba umukozi w'umuntu” igihe cyose; ibi bitanga ikintu mu murongo, ntabwo ari ihererekanya rya PSTN.

errors.CONTACT_CENTER_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Hakenewe uruhushya mbere y'uko ikiganiro gitangira.
errors.CONTACT_CENTER_REALTIME_CONNECT_FAILED: Ntibishoboka kugera ku utanga serivisi y'ijwi rya none aha.
errors.BROWSER_REALTIME_VOICE_UNSUPPORTED: Uru rubuga ntirushyigikira ijwi rya none aha.
